title: Grateful Dead Live at Compton Terrace Amphitheatre on 1982-07-25
lineage: AUD> ?> DAT> CD> EAC> SHN> WAV> CE2K> CDWAVE> SHNTOOL> mkwACT

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a solid 1982 Tempe show with standout Crazy Fingers and a happy Half‑Step, overall well‑played and easy to listen.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as clear and enjoyable, offering a faithful representation of an ’82 Dead concert. Reviewers note strong first‑set work, a solid (if not legendary) second set highlighted by Crazy Fingers and Jerry’s upbeat Half‑Step performance, making it a great pick for fans seeking a typical early‑80s show.

ai_rating.rationale: Multiple reviewers give 4–5 stars, citing good sound quality and well‑played set; only one moderate rating provides a balanced average around 4.0, nudged up by strong positive comments.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Sound described as fine to good and even great in places; no major dropouts or muffling mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set remembered as good, second set solid though not a "Top Ten" night; overall well‑selected representation of an ’82 show.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Happy vocal on Half‑Step, showing his upbeat mood; performance noted as a highlight.
